title: Let the close door see the cells the closing feature just capped
action: Move the build_promotion call so it runs BEFORE auto_archive_on_close retires the feature's cells, and keep the headline and warning lines exactly where they are in close's output (per D9). Today the door sits after retirement, so with cells_archive_on_close at its default true a real close moves the just-capped cells into .bee/cells/archive/ before build_promotion scans .bee/cells/*.json — the close's own proposal comes back empty, which satisfies neither D2 nor PBI P67. build_promotion is read-only, so moving the call earlier has no side effect other than what it can see. The door stays soft: no exit-code change, both None and Thrown still degrade to the same one warning line. Change the happy-path test that kl-3 wrote with cells_archive_on_close set to false so it now runs with archiving at its DEFAULT and still asserts non-zero proposal counts — that assertion is the whole point of this cell.

truths: A green close with cells_archive_on_close at its default emits non-zero promote proposal counts drawn from the cells that close just capped
The headline and warning lines appear in the same position in close's output as before
close's exit code is still unaffected by the promote door

artifacts.substantive: build_promotion computed before auto_archive_on_close, output lines unmoved

key_links: the happy-path close test runs with default archiving and asserts non-zero counts
prohibitions: The retirement behaviour of auto_archive_on_close does not change
close's exit code never changes because of the promote door
